description: Coherent Gate (PAID, x402/USDC). Scores whether your trading-signal paths agree: confidence-weighted long/short/flat consensus, coherence 0-1, and a pass/block gate (pass needs a non-flat consensus and coherence at or above the threshold, default 0.6). Tiers by path count: scout ≤4 $0.01, standard ≤8 $0.05, beast ≤32 $0.25 (defaults). The $0.25 max tier is charged upfront; on the x402 rail the unused difference is recorded as owed (not yet auto-refunded); on the Arc escrow rail (arc_auth_id) only the used tier is captured. Optional ticker pulls extra paths from registered sources before charging. Max 32 paths. Not financial advice.

arc_auth_id.description: Arc rail: authId from AuthCaptureEscrow.authorize() for at least the max-tier amount to our receiver. Only the used tier is captured; the rest returns via reclaim() after expiry.

paths.description: Coherent Gate: AI trading signal paths to check for coherence. Priced tiers: scout ≤4, standard ≤8, beast ≤32 (defaults); >32 hard-rejected.

confidence.description: Weight 0-1 this path gets in the consensus.

direction.description: Direction this path calls: long, short, or flat.

source.description: Label for where this signal came from (1-64 chars).

sources.description: Optional path-source ids; default = all enabled verified sources. Requires ticker.

ticker.description: Optional: pull extra paths for this ticker from registered path sources (see docs/COHERENT_GATE_PATH_SOURCES.md).

name: interfere
